method: Independent Python Decimal (90 working digits, 70-digit report); direct analytical formulas, Decimal square roots/exponentials and argument-reduced Taylor sine. SI decimal spellings are used except explicitly marked exact-binary64 regression fixtures. No JavaScript imports.

cases.name: Zero barrier width gives unit transmission
At the top of the barrier use the finite threshold limit
Near the barrier top is continuous
Extremely opaque barrier reports positive underflow
Ill-conditioned large above-barrier resonance is explicitly rejected
cases.method: Independent cross-review: 90-digit Decimal, exact binary64 SI inputs and supplied binary64 hbar. Precision rejection is required because phase uncertainty changes transmission materially.

cases.name: Binary-scaled phase retains a nonzero subnormal radicand
cases.method: 90-digit Decimal, exact binary64 SI inputs and supplied binary64 hbar. Regression for an inaccurately rounded subnormal 2*m*delta radicand.

cases.name: Binary-scaled below-barrier phase retains a subnormal radicand
cases.method: 90-digit Decimal, exact binary64 SI inputs and supplied binary64 hbar. The below-barrier branch shares the same safely scaled radicand.
